attributes.name: logical_name
attributes.description: Logical name of the clock object

attributes.name: time
attributes.description: Current date and time (date-time format, 12 bytes).

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: Time zone offset in minutes from UTC.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Clock status (e.g. daylight saving active, clock value valid).

attributes.name: daylight_saving_begin
attributes.description: Date and time when daylight saving time begins.

attributes.name: daylight_saving_end
attributes.description: Date and time when daylight saving time ends.

methods.name: adjust_to_quarter
methods.description: Adjust the clock to the nearest quarter hour.

methods.name: adjust_to_minute
methods.description: Adjust the clock to the nearest minute.

methods.name: adjust_to_preset_time
methods.description: Adjust the clock to a preset time value.

methods.name: shift_time
methods.description: Shift the clock time by a given number of seconds.

methods.name: set_daylight_saving_begin_end
methods.description: Set the daylight saving begin and end dates.

methods.name: current_time
methods.description: Get the current time from the clock.
